plugins.name: e2e-suite
plugins.description: All-in-one self-evolving test suite: contract-based e2e skill family (orchestrator + 17 members — joint front/back-end testing, negative paths, persistence boundaries, UX acceptance, visual regression, API contract diff, performance probing, whitebox suites, canary self-evolution, harness-scaffold blueprint) PLUS an automated test gate (Stop-hook enforcement with auto baseline, flaky quarantine, regression blocking; TIA for pytest/go; MCP tools status/run/reset/family_skills (skill-family discovery entry); platform-agnostic gate-core with CLI). One install, full functionality.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 一体化自进化测试套件：契约式联动测试技能家族（总控 + 17 成员），外加自动测试门禁（Stop hook 收工把关：基线全自动、抖动隔离、回归拦截；MCP 四工具（含家族发现入口 family_skills）；判定引擎平台无关并带 CLI）。装一次，全功能。

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: 联动测试套件（技能家族 + 测试门禁）
